title: hieracium semibipes
intro: Hieracium semibipes, commonly known as the yellow hawkweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium semibipes include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve symptoms of jaundice, and support the liver's detoxification process. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium semibipes include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
